verdict.rationale: Postmark documents customizable data retention (default 45 days, up to 365 days) and paid custom activity retention add-on, plus a delete-server API endpoint, giving users some control over how long data is kept. However, there's no explicit documentation of a user-initiated bulk data deletion/export mechanism or GDPR-style right-to-erasure workflow beyond retention settings. Missing for 10: explicit data deletion/erasure API or workflow, independent confirmation of retention enforcement, and details on deleting historical message content on demand.
